width_difference.why: no reference: there is no reference text to measure against

stand_in.rule: fc-match's answer, the face the renderer draws: the build measures text in it only when it is named under typography.families.substitutes, and refuses the page until then

faces.user_can_supply: licensed .ttf, .otf or .ttc files of Söhne (regular, bold), put in /home/user/pptx-skill/aurel/fonts; then run this report again

recipient: Söhne: the deck names it and embeds no font, so a recipient's PowerPoint draws it only if their machine has Söhne (this machine has it only as a stand-in: tell the user)
embedding: not written: LibreOffice 24.2, the one renderer here, drew none of three test decks with an embedded font (sfnt bytes, EOT, EOT with XOR) in that font, so a written font could not be checked; PowerPoint was not measured
never_downloaded: the skill never downloads or installs a font; missing faces come from the user, as files they license
